query: We have 5 people on our team. Help me record their skills, what they want to grow into, and link them to the projects and operational work in our Work Inventory.
expected_behavior: Guides the user interactively with a numbered menu and 1-2 plain-language questions at a time
Captures each team member's current skills/proficiency (L1-L3), growth interests (G), and baseline operational vs. strategic project capacity
Links active work assignments strictly to committed Work Inventory items (WORK-X) and offers Markdown, Mermaid, and Excel-ready CSV outputs after a recap confirmation gate

query: Kyron is the only person who knows how our legacy court statistics scripts work, and he is also leading 4 new projects while Alex wants to learn data analytics. Analyze this and show a visual.
expected_behavior: Flags Kyron as both a single-point-of-failure ('bus factor = 1') on legacy court statistics and an over-allocated bottleneck across 4 concurrent projects
Matches Alex's growth interest in data analytics as a backup/co-mentoring pairing to reduce bus-factor risk and rebalance workload
Generates quoted, valid Mermaid person-to-work flowcharts and capacity allocation visuals in B.C. Government sentence case

query: Export our team skills and project assignments into a format I can open in Excel and also show a Mermaid diagram of who is doing what.
expected_behavior: Generates the Excel-ready CSV tracker (team-work-tracker.csv) with Member ID, Role, Skills, Growth Interests, Work ID, Assignment Role, and Allocation %
Renders a Mermaid flowchart linking team members (MEM-X) to committed work items (WORK-X) and capabilities (CAP-X)

query: The owner confirms 30 percent capacity for WORK-014, which was flagged Capacity unconfirmed.
expected_behavior: Records the allocation with source and date in register 11
Warns if the person's total load exceeds 100 percent
Raises a follow-up for Work mode of developing-and-managing-strategy to clear the flag instead of editing 08 or 10

query: Help me map who is working on what.
expected_behavior: Opens with the action menu and the output-format choice
Asks one or two questions at a time and accepts 'not sure' as an open item
Confirms a recap before saving any register or export
